notes.title: Official Release！
notes.content:
Rivalry Warlord Sengoku, which has been available in Early Access for some time, has now been officially released! Thank you very much for your cooperation.
With the official release, we are planning to revise the price to $8.99
However, for the first week after the release (until August 29th in Japan time), the price will be 700 yen, the same as the early release price, to celebrate the release. Please note that the price will be revised to $8.99 after August 30 (Japan time).
